## Result

- Skill: design-review
- Review status: approved
- Package members: release — docs/design/release/release.md; system — docs/design/system/system.md; design — docs/design/design/design.md; published-skill-first-release-amendment — specs/published-skill-first-repository-simplification.md. Exact identities and contextual subjects are recorded below.
- Upstream review ID: proposal-review-r2, approved/current and unchanged.
- Review ID and round: design-review-r2, round 2.
- Material findings: no new findings; design-r1-f1 and design-r1-f2 resolved by their original reporter in this batch.
- Correction targets: none.
- Recording status: recorded through targeted batch on successful save.
- Open blockers: none.
- Immediate next stage: Route may hand this exact approved package to authorized Delivery planning; this review makes no activity/work transition.
- Claim limitations: Design package approval only. Source removal awaits reviewed Delivery and coherent implementation; no runtime conformance, release execution, publication, Verify or PR readiness is established.

## Reassessment basis and package judgment

The complete first-pass assessment read every package member and all six selected specification/test-specification/ADR originals. Current primary inspection confirms only Release changed among the fifteen recorded engineering/governing/contextual subjects. The entire Release delta and revised contract, diagram, representation, scenario and displacement interactions were reassessed against the original routine-automation and timing obligations. The remaining source-transfer assessment stays substantively applicable: these corrections restore the missing distinctions without changing other source dispositions, technical boundaries, retention applicability or proposal direction. This is a new judgment on the current exact package, not a retargeted r1 approval.

The package now preserves actionable standing process and narrower transaction automation rules, generated/human/historical surfaces, representation contracts, cheap preflight/full proof composition, local/CI relationships, exact public identity, public observation, immutable-write uncertainty/recovery, emergency deferrals and non-deferrable obligations. The complete source map accounts for numbered and substantive unnumbered meaning, representative proof intent, significant decisions and completed historical procedures. Existing operational baseline, fixture, schema and version-specific inputs remain retained. System composition, Design DES-SR-21 applicability and the new-profile-only R7/R8 source amendment remain coherent and prospective until coordinated implementation and successful Verify.

The exact six source removals and bounded architecture sections/paragraphs remain suitable Design decisions, subject to Delivery's actual-reader confirmation. No whole-directory deletion, operational-input removal, extra model, new schema/phase enum or broad validation redesign is selected. Package/candidate metadata has an explicit impacted-or-inspected-unaffected disposition. Fresh whole-change Code Review and distinct Verify remain required. Representative scenarios and combined identity, delayed-public-observation and unresolved-reader hazards provide credible downstream proof derivation without requiring a live release or every historical suite for source-only changes.

## Finding dispositions

- design-r1-f1: resolved. REL-SR-03 now explicitly preserves same package, supported target set, publication channels and evidence schema, excluding emergency/security exceptions, new adapter class, release-schema migration and historical-evidence rewrite. It distinguishes already-approved routine publication from eligibility for routine automation. An owner decision permits explicit special handling, not routine reclassification or assumed tool support. The routine-profile representation, R1–6 displacement and Input domain scenario apply that same boundary. This supplies the exact source Glossary/R5/R6 and RTA-T002/T019 meaning that was missing; no runtime implementation claim follows.
- design-r1-f2: resolved. REL-SR-18 now requires distinct available preflight, local verification, GitHub-job, npm-job, public-smoke and closeout observations. Existing required preparation/publication-wait phase evidence remains. The timing table uses distinct checks under existing phases, expressly retaining closed phase values and availability limitations without inventing measurements. The displacement and External/environment scenario reject substitution of an aggregate for available separate observations. This preserves source R42/RTA-T022 and standing-flow step 12 without a schema expansion, numeric budget or new historical proof obligation.

## Front summary graph

The inline model-owned Mermaid view is explanatory and explicitly follows REL-SR-01–18. It shows generated preparation, candidate checks, failure/missing-proof stop, a separate publication authorization decision, exact verified identity, public observation and recorded recovery. The recovery edge returns to observation rather than automatically republishing; accompanying prose requires public-state inspection before any retry. Evidence begins before publication and retains failed/deferred results. The diagram does not redefine emergency applicability, routine eligibility or downstream stage authority. It is consistent with the detailed runtime and requirements and introduces no separate external example identity. Mermaid source/relationships were inspected; no rendered diagram correctness is claimed.

## Independence, applicability and checks

The same original reporter remains a separate nonauthor reviewer. The parent authored both corrections and the diagram; this reviewer edited no engineering, proposal, activity or work. Original r1 judgment and subjects remain unchanged and stale; its findings retain their origin and receive explicit reporter-owned resolutions. Proposal Review r2 and the other three member subjects are unchanged and remain an adequate basis because the refinements preserve approved direction and their actual interfaces. Existing authoring-r1 checks are not claimed refreshed; refinement-r2 records the new model checks and disclosed readability advisories.

Commands actually used: git diff -- docs/design/release/release.md; primary context with full activity/review/model/finding/blocker/applicability selection; primary subject inspect for every recorded basis; finding set --help; targeted batch. Inspected the current author refinement evidence and its limits. No runtime/package/publication or historical benchmark command was run. Record-store validation and git diff --check are run after saving and reported separately; persistence is not the semantic approval basis.
independence_basis: Original independent reporter reassessed author-owned corrections and front diagram without editing engineering. Parent authored all package members and revisions; reviewer writes assessment/dispositions only.
